name: Gradient-Magnitude Opacity Modulation
aliases: Gradient-Magnitude Opacity Modulation for Encrypted Volume Rendering
definition: A technique to improve visual quality in encrypted volume rendering by pre-calculating gradient magnitude and encrypting it along with data values to modulate opacity.
summary: Gradient-Magnitude Opacity Modulation improves encrypted volume rendering quality by using pre-calculated gradient magnitudes to modulate opacity, preserving edge details lost in standard encrypted compositing.
